He kept the letter in his coat, and he was no longer quite so alone.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一个还没醒来的人。街灯仍亮着，却照不出一个行人。便利店的玻璃后，店员靠着货架打盹。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过潮湿的路面，发出轻微的声响，又很快消失。写字楼黑着，只有几扇窗还留着忘记关的灯。天边泛起一丝灰蓝，鸟还没有叫。整座城市屏住呼吸，等待第一缕光把它重新唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a tiny part itself and asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- It keeps going with smaller and smaller pieces until the piece is so easy it needs no more help, and that's the stopping point.\n- Think of standing between two mirrors: each reflection shows a slightly smaller one inside it, over and over."}
